body.title: House quiz
body.markdown:
A small quiz for the family and the babysitter. Answers are kept per reader; "Again" starts over.

```quiz
title: Do you know our home network?
? Which address does the router have?
- 192.168.1.1
+ 10.20.0.1
- 10.0.0.1
> Since the rebuild in March the home network is 10.20.0.0/24.

? Where is the main water shut-off?
- Under the kitchen sink
+ In the basement, next to the stairs
- In the garage
> The valve turns clockwise to close.

? What is the guest Wi-Fi called?
= Maple Guests
> The password is on the fridge, not here.
```
